meaning: The Model evaluated by this batch job.
The wallet that opened the batch and paid its rent.
Caller-chosen u64 nonce deriving the Batch PDA `["batch", model, caller, nonce_le]`.
32-byte SHA-256 hash of the batch input manifest.
Total number of receipts expected across the batch (`MIN_BATCH_ITEMS = 1` to `MAX_BATCH_ITEMS = 256`).
Count of verified receipts chained into `receipts_root` so far.
Rolling SHA-256 chain root updated per receipt as `sha256(receipts_root || receipt.key() || input_hash || output_hash)`.
The slot the batch was opened in.
